implementation_strategy: Execute the preregistered confirmatory set (n=200) using the hosted_netops_gvr_v1 adapter in its recommended deterministic-repair scenario: one hosted LLM generation per arm per intent (shared initial candidate semantics) and at most one guarded repair call per intent in the guarded arm. Deterministic verification and deterministic rule-based repairs run locally in Docker; all scoring and failure-taxonomy labeling are fully automated by adapter-provided deterministic scorers.
model_and_version_plan: gpt-5-mini (single hosted model; model_version recorded as gpt-5-mini at runtime)
task_manifest_strategy: Use the preregistered CNSM-2026-synthetic-intent-corpus-v1 of 200 confirmed-clean intents; compute and store SHA-256 for each intent pre-execution; enforce exclusion rules automatically.
transformation_manifest_strategy: Apply config_normalization_v1 → cli_tokenizer_v1 → verifier-translation → deterministic_repair_heuristics_v1 (guarded arm). Baseline applies direct_configuration_generation_v1 → config_normalization_v1.
execution_batches: batch_1: intents 1-200 (paired execution across baseline and guarded arms; single cluster)
randomisation_plan: No between-intent randomisation; paired design uses identical intent for both arms. Audit sample (10%) selected via fixed RNG seed for reproducible audit selection.
caching_plan: Cache deterministic normalization and verifier translations locally to ensure idempotent evaluation; model responses not cached beyond adapter's standard transient logs per provider policy.
failure_recovery_plan: Single automatic retry for transient provider/API timeouts (60s backoff). Provider errors counted as failures per missingness_plan. Dockerized verifier/repair failures trigger up to 2 auto-retries for replay audit; persistent infra failures logged and abort reported.
estimated_compute_notes: Estimated_model_calls = 200 intents × (1 baseline call + 1 guarded initial generation) + up to 0 additional hosted repair calls under the recommended deterministic-repair scenario = 400 calls total. Dockerized verifier and repair run on CPU-only environment; hosted LLM calls via model_provider openai_responses; total planned calls (400) ≤ capability manifest maximum_planned_model_calls (10000).
